title: 3×3の表情シート（同一キャラ9パネル）をリファレンスとして使い、矢印で表情変化の順番を誘導して再現性を検証する
content:
3×3の表情シート（同一キャラ9パネル）をリファレンスとして使い、矢印で表情変化の順番を誘導して再現性を検証する  
プロンプトにStop Motionを入れて、9種類の表情をリファレンスに近い順番で再現させやすくする  
矢印やルート指定を描き込んで、カメラ動きだけでなくキャラクターの移動経路も意図通りに誘導する  
プロンプトで移動を細かく指示するだけでなく、進ませたいルートを直接描いたリファレンスを併用して狙いに近づける

en.content:
Using a 3×3 expression sheet (same character in 9 panels) as a reference, guide the order of expression changes with arrows to verify reproducibility.  
Include "Stop Motion" in the prompt to make it easier to reproduce the 9 expressions in an order close to the reference.  
Draw arrows and specify routes to guide not only the camera movement but also the character's movement path as intended.  
In addition to specifying movements in detail in the prompt, use a reference with the desired route drawn directly to achieve results closer to the target.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
It seems that the arrows and route specifications in Seedance 2.0 significantly affect not only the camera movement but also the character's movement path.  
By not only giving detailed instructions for character movement in the prompt but also drawing the desired route directly, you can achieve results closer to your intention. 🐰
